presentation.notes: Three original long/short tunic and lamellar shell meshes with their source skin and UVs, six CC BY-SA input files by Wildfire Games. Quaternius CC0 walk, formal march and jog are fitted to held loads on a shared palette. Default window and both close archer views are from living actors. Facial noise, repeated features and close overlaps under review.
rejected: The first dark armour coat had a pale breech band outside the garment. Excluded those UV islands on revision two.
The first 5.8 m review crop projected 1280 design coordinates directly onto the 1920 image and showed foliage. Native pixel projection was corrected and then archer #94 was replayed from both sides.
Unrestrained unarmed jog rotated the shoulders through 79.8 degrees; loaded weapons now shorten this arc.
RC15 full export film originally timed out while new frames were still arriving, later replayed to completion on the identical Linux package.

linux.renderer: Ubuntu 24.04, Godot 4.6.3, llvmpipe, software OpenGL. Four sizes, 1280x800, native resolution, 4x MSAA, shadows. Short 20 rendered frames per size; movie fixed-time data are not used for performance.
